From Heart

Ek Chhoti Si Chitthi 💝

Meri pyaari Hukum,


Aaj ke din, jab poori duniya aapke liye ek khaas din mana rahi hai, main chahta hoon ki aap jaanein — aap mere liye kitni khaas hain.


Aapki har hansi mujhe chain deti hai, aapka har gussa bhi pyaara lagta hai 😅, aur aapka saath… woh toh sirf ek ehsaas hai jo alfaazon mein nahi aata.


Is birthday pe meri ek hi dua hai — aap hamesha muskurayein, hamesha khush rahein, aur hamesha mere dil ke kareeb rahein. 🌹


Aapka yeh din bahut bahut khaas ho — jaise aap hain mere liye. Happy Birthday, Hukum. ✨

— Aapka 💕
